text:
ashley: Spinning up EU6 GPU cluster — requesting observability handoff and quick validation of logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, and alerting templates. Nodes are provisioned, VPC peering done, kube join completed. fluent-bit helm chart is installed but currently forwarding to a staging bucket. ping @mateo @lin @sre-bot :wave:

mateo: Got it. Can you paste the fluent-bit values you used? also need `kubectl get pods -n telemetry` output and the collector config.

lin: quick checklist from platform side — confirm the following before handoff:
- logs: fluent-bit -> s3/gcs or kinesis? ensure multiline & JSON parsing rules
- metrics: prometheus scrape targets for node-exporter, kube-state, and inference pods
- traces: otel-collector running with correct exporter (otlp -> jaeger/tempo)
- dashboards: grafana folder export + UID mapping
- alerts: paging rules + runbook links

samira: FYI cost note — EU6 network egress and high-cardinality logs from GPU job ids tend to spike. If you're shipping raw inference traces with full token payloads we'll need sampling or PII redaction. Suggest: sample 1/50 and redact >64-char fields. :warning:

devon: Tracing question — inference service (inference-svc-v2) currently uses OTLP over grpc. Collector config I used in eu6 snippet below. Please apply to the otel-collector configmap if missing:

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  tempo:
    endpoint: tempo.eu6.internal:14268
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [tempo]
```

mateo: fluent-bit values excerpt (what I applied):
```yaml
outputs:
  - name: s3
    match: gpu-logs.*
    bucket: redwood-eu6-logs
    total_file_size: 100M
filters:
  - name: record_modifier
    match: *
    remove: ["full_request_body"]
```

ashley: thanks. two infra gotchas we hit during staging rollout: kube-proxy taints on new gpu nodes causing scrape failure for node-exporter, and a broken serviceaccount rolebinding preventing fluent-bit from reading secret creds. fixed with:
`kubectl taint nodes --all node-role.kubernetes.io/gpu-` and adding the rolebinding `telemetry-fluentbit-reader`.

lin: Good catches. For dashboards — export the grafana folder as JSON and set UID stable names (we use `eu6-inference` prefix). Also add a dashboard panel for: GPU mem utilization (per pod), token-per-second rate, and KV-cache hit ratio.

samira: Alerting templates we should enable before handoff:
- gpu_node_oom_rate > 0.01 for 5m -> page oncall
- inference_5xx_rate > 0.005 for 10m -> page + failover to cheaper model pool
- prom_disk_full > 0.9 -> page SRE, but runbook has cleanup steps
Attach short runbook links in the alert annotations.

mateo: Running `kubectl get pods -n telemetry` now — outputs look healthy except otel-collector is CrashLoopBackOff on one replica. logs show "failed to connect to tempo endpoint: connection refused". suspect service DNS.

devon: Tempo svc is `tempo-observability.eu6.svc.cluster.local:14268` — check kube-dns. You can `kubectl exec -n telemetry <collector-pod> -- nslookup tempo-observability` and `curl -v http://tempo-observability:14268/` from the pod.

ashley: did that — DNS resolves but connection refused from pod to tempo. Turns out tempo was scheduled on GPU nodes without the storage class available; tempo couldn't write chunks and is crashlooping. Remediated by rescheduling tempo to control-plane nodes (`kubectl patch deployment tempo -p "{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"node-role.kubernetes.io/control":"true"}}}}}"`). After reschedule collector is stable.

sre-bot: Created ticket INFRA-3847 to track post-mortem for tempo storage issue. Assigned to mateo, priority P2. :ticket:

lin: Next steps for handoff:
1) mateo to export grafana folder + attach template UIDs and share a `grafana-export.zip` in this thread.
2) samira to finalize sampling + redact rules in fluent-bit filter chain.
3) devon to update otel-collector configmap and increase replica count to 3.
4) ashley to run smoke tests: logs arrive (last 15m), prometheus targets up, traces show spans from inference-svc.

ashley: I'll run the checks now and report back. smokes: logs showing gpu-logs prefix ✅, prometheus target `inference-svc:9100` UP ✅, traces visible in Tempo for sampled requests ✅. Creating handoff doc with links to dashboards and alert runbooks.

oncall_bot: Handoff acknowledged. Oncall rotation for EU6 has been updated. Next oncall: @lin (72h). Leaving this channel in 1h if no blockers. :white_check_mark:

mateo: Uploading grafana-export.zip to shared drive at https://drive.internal/redwood/eu6/grafana-export.zip — contains dashboard UIDs and an alerts folder.

samira: I'll push fluent-bit filters to the eu6 values and open a PR for the sampling policy. Expect a small cost delta if we reduce sampling from 1/10 -> 1/50.

ashley: Great work team, feel free to add any follow-ups. I'll mark the thread resolved after the PRs merge and the runbook link is in the alert annotations. :pray:
